summary: Frontend-only testing of the Ledger beat restructure and ANY INDUSTRY beat reformatting. All 7 specified features verified via DOM inspection and visual screenshots.

1_ledger_eyebrow.detail: Eyebrow 'THE POWERS EXPERIENCE: SHOP FLOOR TO TOP FLOOR' present in EvidenceBeat (station-index div with text-transform:uppercase applied by CSS). Raw text: 'The Powers Experience: Shop Floor to Top Floor'.

2_ledger_2col_top_row.detail: ev-top-grid renders as CSS grid with 2 columns (527px + 553px at 1440px viewport). Left col (.ev-h2-col) contains H2 'Decades of partnership. Outcomes that last.', right col contains .it-sidebar (data-testid=testimonial-beat). Parent of sidebar confirmed as 'ev-top-grid wipe wipe-d1'.

3_behlen_video_play_button.detail: data-testid=testimonial-play-btn is visible. Clicking it replaces facade with YouTube iframe (data-testid=testimonial-iframe) — autoplay confirmed working.

4_stats_grid_full_width.detail: 5-stat grid (wipe wipe-d2) renders full-width below the top row. 5 children confirmed. Stats include: $701M (counting toward $1B+), 71% (toward 98%), 3 wks (toward 5 wks), 191+ (toward 500+), 9+ (toward 30+). Count-up animation active on scroll entry.

5_any_industry_2col_no_behlen.detail: IndustriesAndTestimonialBeat uses .it-body-grid (2-col: 527px + 553px). Left col (.it-main) has eyebrow 'ANY INDUSTRY. ANY FLOOR.' + H2. Right col (.it-lede-col) has lede paragraph. No .it-sidebar found inside this section.

6_logo_crawl_below_any_industry.detail: data-testid=logo-crawl and .industries-logos-label present. Label text: 'We've worked shoulder to shoulder with'. Logo crawl (ADM, Alcoa, BAE Systems visible) renders full-width below the 2-col body grid.

7_no_duplicate_behlen.detail: .it-sidebar count=1, .it-behlen-logo count=1, data-testid=testimonial-play-btn count=1. Behlen card appears exactly once — in the Ledger beat (EvidenceBeat).

critical_code_review_comments: itBeatCss is injected via <style>{itBeatCss}</style> inside EvidenceBeat — this means the same CSS block (including .it-body-grid, .it-lede-col, .it-sidebar, .it-facade, etc.) injects correctly for both EvidenceBeat and IndustriesAndTestimonialBeat since they share the DOM. No duplication issues.

ev-top-grid align-items: end means the H2 aligns to the bottom of the sidebar card — visually the H2 sits low while the sidebar card sits high. This is the designed behavior per the layout spec but worth flagging if editorial wants the H2 vertically centered against the sidebar.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Ledger beat restructure fully verified at iteration_21. EvidenceBeat (Beat V): eyebrow 'THE POWERS EXPERIENCE: SHOP FLOOR TO TOP FLOOR', ev-top-grid 2-col (H2 left + Behlen sidebar right), 5-stat full-width grid below. IndustriesAndTestimonialBeat: 2-col it-body-grid (eyebrow+H2 left, lede right), logo crawl below, NO Behlen sidebar. No duplicate Behlen cards anywhere on page. Play button functional (facade→iframe swap). All 7 acceptance criteria PASS.
